tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Night = 1989 Tokyo after dark; Day = cream manual paper.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Window/panel bodies, cards, form fields.

tokens.name: crt
tokens.usage: Dark terminal panel in BOTH themes: tickers, readouts, code. Only place phosphor text appears.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and the 2px window borders. 15.7:1 on surface (Night), 14.6:1 (Day).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, metadata. 9.1:1 Night, 7.2:1 Day.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hard 2px borders on windows, buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: sunset-pink
tokens.usage: Brand. Primary buttons, active states, one call to action per screen. Day: fill only, never text (3.1:1 on surface).

tokens.name: sunset-orange
tokens.usage: Warm accent: the sun motif, highlights, hover.

tokens.name: dusk-violet
tokens.usage: Deep accent: window title bars, section bands, footer.

tokens.name: cel-teal
tokens.usage: Cool accent: tags, secondary badges, Night links. At most once per section.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on sunset-pink, sunset-orange, cel-teal fills (4.8:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text on dusk-violet title bars (5.8:1 Night, 6.9:1 Day).

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Green CRT text, only on crt panels.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Rising numbers. Pair with ▲ so color is not the only signal.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Falling numbers. Pair with ▼ so color is not the only signal.

tokens.name: crt-gain
tokens.usage: Rising numbers on crt panels in both themes (gain's Day value is too dark there).

tokens.name: crt-loss
tokens.usage: Falling numbers on crt panels in both themes.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Hero title only, once per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles; minimum size for Dela Gothic One.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, pixel nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and title bars; base grid unit.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Window padding, button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero padding, major section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: windows, buttons, images, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Maximum, for tiny chips only. Never round past this.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows only. No blur, ever. Night uses a violet shadow because a dark one vanishes on the navy surface.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Windows, cards, primary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Button hover/pressed (move element +2px,+2px).
